mentions.name: Claude Code session auto-resumer
mentions.description: This tool automatically resumes a Claude Code session in the same terminal once the user's quota resets, removing the need to manually type "please continue" after waiting for quota to resume.
mentions.problem: When the Claude Code quota runs out, the user has to wake up and manually type "please continue" to resume the session once quota resumes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been thinking about and working on a solution to automatically resume a Claude code session in the same terminal when my quota resumes. I hate waking up and typing "please continue"
